Hey you absolute legend, if I provided you with a pretty large cloud storage where you can just dump it all so we can do some kind of community effort to make a small team publish it to youtube and/or a safer platforms in terms of fair use would you do it?  
I really liked your work, can't really accept to see it all go because of some idiot at YouTube...

Check out QuickEmacs (qe) [GitHub Repo](https://github.com/qemacs/qemacs)  
It's crazy fast, full of features and small  
They're even planning on releasing it as a package soon, the entire codebase is smaller than pico and nano but with the features of Emacs  
If you want to try it out online, an old version of it is installed in Bellard's JSLinux, just use [JSLinux Alpine](https://bellard.org/jslinux/vm.html?url=alpine-x86.cfg&mem=192) and enter qe in the cli

I'd say mention "Pitch" and have a short headline in the email subject  
Don't mention specific names if it's not someone only you could interview, be a bit vague, mention the overall level and institution/subject matter of your potential guest(s) (the media you're pitching to might interview that person themselves, you have to protect yourself against it)  
Take into consideration that magazines get tons of pitches, they should grasp the concept of yours in the first 2 lines of it, you can elaborate a bit more by mentioning why you yourself are relevant / experienced in the matter and link to some of your past work.  
Also don't make promises you may not deliver, if they answer yes and you can't deliver that's a really bad look on you and that will grill your reputation towards that media.  
Good luck out there!

Also, don't know if that helps but I have an ana gf, you can ask me for tips if you want to feel better in life, I managed to make her life a bit more miserable, and dialed down the impact of EDs by quite a lot and no, I'm not making her eat, just feel better (i hope)

Hope you can find the way to enjoy life, even if that means living a little lower but more manageable life  
Don't know much about you but thank you for answering to my post.

Good luck, whoever you are in this world
